name: TabBar
description: Compose primary application navigation for a narrow viewport, with labelled items and active-state feedback.

slots.name: Root
slots.signature: ({ className, children, condensed: forced, maxItems, ...rest }: ComponentProps<"nav"> & { "aria-label": string; condensed?: boolean; maxItems?: number; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: condensed
props.description: Force the condensed state (documentation); by default it follows scrolling.

props.name: maxItems
props.description:
The most tabs the bar shows, More included. Tabs beyond it, or too narrow to stay readable
at the bar's width, move into More's sheet, and the current destination stays in the bar.
A TabBar.More you write keeps its own rows, after those; without one, More appears when needed.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
